global: A bowl of rich, orange miso ramen broth glistens, topped with shredded cabbage and a whole boiled egg. The white ceramic bowl sits on a wooden table, warmly lit, with chopsticks resting nearby.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with smooth texture and subtle natural wood markings.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, slightly raised rim, and faint brown residue stains along inner edge.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth with noodles, garnished with shredded cabbage and a soft-boiled egg, appears rich, orange-brown, and glossy.
regions.egg: A whole boiled egg, pale yellowish-white, smooth surface with faint brown speckles, oval shape.
